reading.zh: 同一块界面的两面：panel 脚本管行为（取当前时期、图标复用、点击信息、底部按钮），prefab 是 UIManager 按 PanelType 名实例化的冻结层级。
reading.en: Two sides of the same screen: the panel script owns behaviour (era lookup, icon pooling, click info, bottom buttons) and the prefab owns the frozen hierarchy that UIManager instantiates by PanelType name.
